observedQuestCandidates.sourceText: It is written in the Book of Thoth:

quest.sourceTemplate:
It is written in the Book of %d:

    After the Creation, the cruel god Moloch rebelled
    against the authority of Marduk the Creator.
    Moloch stole from Marduk the most powerful of all
    the artifacts of the gods, the Amulet of Yendor,
    and he hid it in the dark cavities of Gehennom, the
    Under World, where he now lurks, and bides his time.

Your %G %d seeks to possess the Amulet, and with it
to gain deserved ascendance over the other gods.

You, a newly trained %r, have been heralded
from birth as the instrument of %d.  You are destined
to recover the Amulet for your deity, or die in the
attempt.  Your hour of destiny has come.  For the sake
of us all:  Go bravely with %d!

#               [m] enter and perform an extended command
apply           [m] apply (use) a tool (pick-axe, key, lamp...)
call                name a monster, specific object, or type of object
chronicle       [A] show journal of major events
conduct         [A] list voluntary challenges you have maintained
dip            [mA] dip an object into something
engrave             engrave writing on the floor
enhance         [A] advance or check weapon and spell skills
fight               prefix: force fight even if you don't see a monster
genocided      [mA] list monsters that have been genocided or become extinct
glance              show what type of thing a map symbol corresponds to
herecmdmenu     [A] show menu of commands you can do here
history         [A] show a summary of the game's development
inventtype          show inventory of one specific item class
invoke          [A] invoke an object's special powers
known           [m] show what object types have been discovered
knownclass      [m] show discovered types for one class of objects
look                look at what is here
lookaround          describe what you can see
loot           [mA] loot a box on the floor
name            [A] same as call; name a monster or object or object type
offer          [mA] offer a sacrifice to the gods
optionsfull     [m] show all option settings, possibly change them
overview       [mA] show a summary of the explored dungeon
pickup          [m] pick up things at the current location
pray            [A] pray to the gods for help
puton               put on an accessory (ring, amulet, etc)
quit            [A] exit without saving current game
read                read a scroll or spellbook
remove              remove an accessory (ring, amulet, etc)
reqmenu             prefix: request menu or modify command
retravel            travel to previously selected travel location
ride            [A] mount or dismount a saddled steed
rub             [A] rub a lamp or a stone
run                 prefix: run until something interesting is seen
rush                prefix: rush until something interesting is seen
save                save the game and exit
search          [m] search for traps and secret doors
seeall          [m] show all equipment in use
seeamulet       [m] show the amulet currently worn
seearmor        [m] show the armor currently worn
seerings        [m] show the ring(s) currently worn
seetools        [m] show the tools currently in use
seeweapon       [m] show the weapon currently wielded
shell               leave game to enter a sub-shell ('exit' to come back)
showgold        [m] show gold, possibly shop credit or debt
showspells          list and reorder known spells
showtrap            describe an adjacent, discovered trap
suspend             push game to background ('fg' to come back)
swap                swap wielded and secondary weapons
takeoff             take off one piece of armor
terrain         [A] view map without monsters or objects obstructing it
therecmdmenu    [A] menu of commands you can do from here to adjacent spot
travel          [m] travel to a specific location on the map
version         [A] list compile time options for this version of NetHack
versionshort    [m] show version and date+time program was built
wait            [m] rest one move while doing nothing
wear                wear a piece of armor
whatdoes            tell what a command does
whatis              show what type of thing a symbol corresponds to
wield               wield (put in use) a weapon
